description: An abstract Angular component class for configuring latest chart widgets in the Thingsboard UI, including form setup, validation, and configuration handling.

classes.name: LatestChartBasicConfigComponent
classes.description: An abstract Angular component class for configuring latest chart widgets, providing form management, validation, and configuration logic.

methods.name: configForm
methods.description: Returns the form group used for widget configuration.

methods.name: setupConfig
methods.description: Initializes configuration parameters based on widget config data.

methods.name: onConfigSet
methods.description: Sets up the form with current widget configuration data.

methods.name: prepareOutputConfig
methods.description: Prepares and returns the widget configuration data for output.

methods.name: validatorTriggers
methods.description: Returns list of form control names that trigger validation updates.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Enables or disables form controls based on current form state.

methods.name: setupLatestChartControls
methods.description: Abstract method for setting up specific chart controls.

methods.name: prepareOutputLatestChartConfig
methods.description: Abstract method for preparing specific chart configuration output.

methods.name: latestChartValidatorTriggers
methods.description: Returns additional validator trigger control names.

methods.name: updateLatestChartValidators
methods.description: Abstract method for updating specific chart validators.

methods.name: defaultSettings
methods.description: Abstract method to provide default settings for the chart.

methods.name: latestChartConfigTemplate
methods.description: Abstract method to provide the template for chart configuration UI.

methods.name: getCardButtons
methods.description: Determines which card buttons are enabled based on config.

methods.name: setCardButtons
methods.description: Sets card button states in the widget config.

methods.name: _valuePreviewFn
methods.description: Generates a preview string for value display.

methods.name: _tooltipValuePreviewFn
methods.description: Generates a preview string for tooltip value display.
